t: Find the greatest number that will divide 49, 147 and 322 to leave the same remainder in each case.
e: We know that: If two or more numbers give the same remainder when divided by some other number, then their difference must give a remainder of zero when divided by that number. So, Greatest number that will divide 49, 147 and 322 to leave the same remainder in each case = HCF of (147 - 49), (322 - 49), and (322 - 147) = HCF of 98, 273, and 175 98 = 2 * 72 273 = 3 * 7 * 13 175 = 52 * 7 HCF of 98, 273, and 175 = 7 Hence, required number = 7
h: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिससे 49, 147 और 322 को विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में समान शेषफल प्राप्त होता है।

t: Find the least number which when divided by 6, 9, 15, and 20 leaves remainder 1 in each case, and is divisible by 17.
e:
Factor of 6 = 2 * 3
Factor of 9 = 3<sup>2</sup>
Factor of 15 = 3 * 5
Factor of 20 = 2<sup>2</sup> * 5
LCM = 4 * 9 * 5 = 180
Required number = 180k + 1 (where k is an integer)
Try k = 1,
180 * 1 + 1 = 181 (not divisible by 17)
Try k = 2
180 * 2 + 1 = 361 (not divisible by 17)
Try k = 3
180 * 3 + 1 = 541 (not divisible by 17)
Try k = 4
180 * 4 + 1 = 721 (not divisible by 17)
Try k = 5
180 * 5 + 1 = 901 (divisible by 17)
h: वह सबसे छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे 6, 9, 15 और 20 से विभाजित करने पर प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल 1 बचे तथा वह 17 से विभाज्य हो।

t: If N = 6<sup>6</sup> + 6<sup>9</sup> + 6<sup>10</sup> + 6<sup>7</sup>, then how many positive factors of N are there?
e:
N = 6<sup>6</sup> + 6<sup>9</sup> + 6<sup>10</sup> + 6<sup>7</sup>
N = 6<sup>6</sup> * (1 + 6<sup>3</sup> + 6<sup>4</sup> + 6)
N = (2 * 3)<sup>6</sup> * [(1 + 6<sup>3</sup>) + 6(1 + 6<sup>3</sup>)]
N = 2<sup>6</sup> * 3<sup>6</sup> * (1 + 6<sup>3</sup>) * (1 + 6)
N = 2<sup>6</sup> * 3<sup>6</sup> * 217 * 7
N = 2<sup>6</sup> * 3<sup>6</sup> * 7 * 31 * 7
N = 2<sup>6</sup> * 3<sup>6</sup> * 7<sup>2</sup> * 31
If N = a<sup>p</sup> * b<sup>q</sup> * c<sup>r</sup> [Where a, b and c are prime], then total positive factors of N = (p + 1)(q + 1)(r + 1).
Hence, positive factors of N = (6 + 1) * (6 + 1) * (2 + 1) * (1 + 1) = 7 * 7 * 3 * 2 = 294
h: यदि N = 6<sup>6</sup> + 6<sup>9</sup> + 6<sup>10</sup> + 6<sup>7 </sup>है, तो N के कितने धनात्मक गुणनखंड हैं?

t: The sum of the two numbers is 45. Their HCF and LCM are 5 and 70 respectively. Find the sum of the reciprocal of the two numbers.
e:
Since the HCF of two numbers is 5, the let the numbers are 5a and 5b respectively. ['a' and 'b' are co-prime numbers and a > b.]
LCM of 5a and 5b = 5ab = 70
ab = 14 ...... (1)
Sum of two numbers = 5a + 5b = 45
a + b = 9 ....... (2)
From (1) and (2):
(a + b)/ab = 9/14
a/ab + b/ab = 9/14
1/b + 1/a = 9/14
Sum of reciprocal of the two numbers = 1/5a + 1/5b = 9/(5 * 14)
= 9/70
h: दो संख्याओं का योग 45 है। उनका महत्तम समापवर्त्य और लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्रमशः 5 और 70 है। तो दो संख्याओं के व्युत्क्रम का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

t:
a, b, c and 23 are four distinct number and the HCF of each pair of numbers (23, a) ; (23, b) ; (23, c) is 23 where a, b, c are each less than 95 and a < b < c. what is the value of
(b * c + a)/2
e:
The four distinct numbers are 23, a, b and c
HCF is always the factor of the given numbers
a, b, c should be multiple of 23 as the HCF is 23
Only possible multiples of a, b and c is 2, 3 and 4 respectively
As a, b and c each are less than 95
So, a = 23 * 2 = 46
b = 23 * 3 = 69
c = 23 * 4 = 92
(b * c + a)/2 = (69 * 92 + 46)/2
=> (6348 + 46)/2 = 6394/2
=> 3197

t: Which is the largest six-digit number, which when divided by 12,15, 20, 24 and 30, leaves the remainders 8, 11, 16, 20 and 26, respectively.
e:
The LCM of 12, 15 20,24, 30 = 120
the greatest of 6-digit = 999999
Dividing 999999 by 120 we get 39 as the remainder
Hence the 6-digit number divisible by 120 is (999999-39)
= 999960
Since 12-8=4, 15-11 = 4, 20-16=4, 24-20= 4, 30-26 = 4
then reminder is each case is =4 less than the divisor
Hence, Required number = 999960-4 = 999956
h: छह अंकों वाली सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन सी है, जिसे 12, 15, 20, 24 और 30 से विभाजित करने पर क्रमशः 8, 11, 16, 20 और 26 शेष बचते हैं?

t: Find the LCM of a<sup>3</sup>+b<sup>3</sup> and c<sup>3</sup>+d<sup>3</sup>, where a= 5, b= 4, c=10 and d=2.
e:
According to the Question,
LCM of a<sup>3</sup>+b<sup>3</sup> and c<sup>3</sup>+d<sup>3 </sup>
Given that: a= 5, b= 4, c=10 and d=2
a<sup>3</sup>+b<sup>3 </sup>= 5<sup>3</sup>+4<sup>3 </sup>= 125 + 64 = 189
c<sup>3</sup>+d<sup>3 </sup>= 10<sup>3</sup>+2<sup>3 </sup>= 1000 + 8 = 1008
Now, LCM of 189 and 1008 is to be determined
Factors of 189 = 3 x 3 x 3 x 7
Factors of 1008 = 2x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 7
So, LCM = 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 7= 3024
h: a<sup>3</sup>+b<sup>3</sup> और c<sup>3</sup>+d<sup>3</sup> का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ a= 5, b= 4, c=10 और d=2 है।

t: A fruit vendor has a number of apples. If he tries to pack them in groups of 3, 4, 6 or 9, there are 2 apples left. But if he packs them in groups of 7, there are none left. Find the least number of apples he has.
e:
LCM of 3, 4, 6 and 9 = 36
Least number(N) = 36k + 2
N ≡ 0 (mod 7)
36k + 2 ≡ 0 (mod 7)
36k ≡ - 2 ≡ 5(mod 7)
Now reduce 36 mod 7
36/7 = 5 remainder 1, so 36 ≡ 1 mod 7
So the equation becomes
1k ≡ 5 (mod 7)
k ≡ 5 (mod 7)
take smallest k = 5
N = 36 * 5 + 2 = 182 (when divided by 3, 4, 6 and 9 leaves remainder 2)
h: एक फल विक्रेता के पास कई सेब हैं। अगर वह उन्हें 3, 4, 6 या 9 के समूहों में पैक करता है, तो 2 सेब बचते हैं। लेकिन अगर वह उन्हें 7 के समूहों में पैक करता है, तो एक भी सेब नहीं बचता। उसके पास सेबों की सबसे कम संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: If the highest common factor (HCF) of x and y is 15, then the HCF of 36x^2 - 81y^2 and 81x^2 - 9y^2 is divisible by:
h: यदि x और y का महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 15 है, तो 36x<sup>2</sup> - 81y<sup>2</sup> और 81x<sup>2</sup> - 9y<sup>2</sup> का HCF _____ से विभाज्य है।

t: Soldiers are to be arranged in rows of 5, 6, 8 or 10. In each case, 1 soldier is left out. But when arranged in rows of 11, no soldier is left. What is the minimum number of soldiers in the parade?
e:
LCM of 5, 6, 8 and 10 = 120
Least number(N) = 120k + 1
N ≡ 0 (mod 11)
120k + 1 ≡ 0 (mod 11)
120k ≡ -1 ≡ 10 (mod 11)
Reduce 120 mod 11 :
120/11 = 10 remainder 10, so 120 ≡ 10 mod 11
10k ≡ 10 (mod 11)
Divide both sides by 10
k ≡ 1 (mod 11)
take smallest value of k = 1
N = 120 * 1 + 1 = 121
h: सैनिकों को 5, 6, 8 या 10 की पंक्तियों में खड़ा किया जाना है। हर बार 1 सैनिक छूट जाता है। लेकिन 11 की पंक्तियों में खड़ा करने पर कोई सैनिक नहीं बचता। परेड में सैनिकों की न्यूनतम संख्या कितनी होनी चाहिए?

t: HCF and LCM of two numbers are 21 and 2457 respectively. If one number lies between 170 to 200, then the number is :
e:
Let the numbers are 21a and 21b
LCM * HCF = product of two numbers
21 * 2457 = 21a * 21b
ab = (21 * 2457)/(21 * 21)
ab = 117
Two co- prime numbers with product 117 are 13 and 9
Therefore, the required number is (21 * 13, 21 * 9) = 273 and 189
Number which lies between 170 to 200 = 189
h: दो संख्याओं का HCF और LCM क्रमशः 21 और 2457 है। यदि एक संख्या 170 से 200 के बीच है, तो वह संख्या है:

t: The ratio of the LCM of two numbers to the sum of the same two numbers is 12:7, if their HCF is 4, what is the product of these two numbers?
e:
As the HCF of numbers is 4, let the numbers be 4y and 4z.
LCM of given two numbers = 4yz
As per given condition:
(4yz)/(4y+4z) = 12/7
yz/(y+z) = 12/7
yz = 12 and y+z = 7
For the above condition,
y = 4 and z = 3
Numbers = 4 X 4 = 16 and 3 X 4 = 12
Product of numbers = 16 X 12 = 192
h: दो संख्याओं के लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) और समान संख्याओं के योगफल का अनुपात 12:7 है। यदि उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 4 है, तो इन दोनों संख्याओं का गुणनफल कितना है?

t: The least number of square tiles required to pave the ceiling of a room 525 centimetre long and 378 centimetre broad is:
e:
To minimize the number of square tiles, use the largest possible tile size, which is the GCD of 525 cm and 378 cm.
GCD = 21
Tile side = 21 cm.
Tiles along length = 525 / 21 = 25
Tiles along breadth = 378 / 21 = 18
Total tiles = 25 * 18 = 450
Option (d) is the correct answer.
h: 525 सेंटीमीटर लंबे और 378 सेंटीमीटर चौड़े कमरे की छत बिछाने के लिए आवश्यक न्यूनतम वर्गाकार टाइलों की संख्या है:

t: The LCM of two numbers is 15 times their HCF. One number is the only cube between 100 and 200. The other number is 60% of the first number. Find the product of the digits of LCM.
e:
Let HCF = X then LCM = 15X
One number is the only cube between 100 and 200, which is 125.
Therefore, one number is 125.
Second number = 125 * 60/100 = 75
Now,
75 * 125 = X * 15X
X<sup>2</sup> = 625
X = 25
Therefore,
LCM = 15 * 25 = 375
Required product = 3 * 7 * 5 = 105.
h: दो संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) उनके महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) का 15 गुना है। एक संख्या 100 और 200 के बीच का एकमात्र घन है। दूसरी संख्या, पहली संख्या की 60% है। लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) के अंकों का गुणनफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The product of the two numbers is 1500 and their HCF is 10. The number of such possible pairs is/are:
e:
Product of the two numbers = 1500
Highest common factor is 10.
Let numbers be 10x and 10y.
So, 10x * 10y = 1500
=> x * y = 15
The possible pairs of x and y are (1, 15), (5, 3) .
So, (10, 150), (50, 30) are the two possible pairs.
h: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल 1500 है और उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 10 है। इस प्रकार ऐसे संभावित युग्मों की संख्या है/हैं :

t: HCF of 2<sup>3</sup> * 3 * 5<sup>2</sup> * 11* 13, 2<sup>2</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>3</sup> * 11 and 2 * 3<sup>5</sup> * 7 * 11.
e:
For HCF, we take the least power.
Taking the least power of each digit -
Least power of 2 = 1
Least power of 3 = 1
Least power of 5 = 0
Least power of 7 = 0
Least power of 13 = 0
Least power of 11 = 1
HCF = 2<sup>1</sup> * 3<sup>1</sup> * 11 = 66
h: 2<sup>3</sup> * 3 * 5<sup>2</sup> * 11* 13, 2<sup>2</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>3</sup> * 11 and 2 * 3<sup>5</sup> * 7 * 11 का HCF ज्ञात करें

t: There are 540 ml, 810 ml, and 900 ml of three different juices. They need to be poured into equal-sized bottles without mixing. How many bottles will be required?
e:
Factor of 540 = 2<sup>2</sup> * 3<sup>3</sup> * 5
Factor of 810 = 2 * 3<sup>4</sup> * 5
Factor of 900 = 2<sup>2</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>2</sup>
HCF = 2 * 9 * 5 = 90 ml
540/90 = 6 bottles
810/90 = 9 bottles
900/90 = 10 bottles
Total number of bottles = 6 + 9 + 10 = 25 bottles
h: तीन अलग-अलग जूस 540 मिली, 810 मिली और 900 मिली हैं। इन्हें बिना मिलाए बराबर आकार की बोतलों में डालना है। कितनी बोतलों की ज़रूरत होगी?

t: Let x be the greatest number which when divides 6475, 4984 and 4132, the remainder in each case is the same. What is the sum of digits of x?
h: मान लें x वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या है जिससे 6475, 4984 और 4132 को भाग देने पर प्रत्येक में समान शेष बचता है। x के अंकों का योग क्या है?

t: What will be the least number which when doubled will be exactly divisible by 12, 14, 16 and 18?
h: वह न्यूनतम संख्या क्या होगी, जिसे दोगुना करने पर वह 12, 14, 16 और 18 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो जाए?

t: The largest four-digit number which is exactly divisible by each one of the numbers 15, 25, 90 and 125.
e:
Factor of 15 = 3 * 5
Factor of 25 = 5 * 5
Factor of 90 = 2 * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5
Factor of 125 = 5<sup>3</sup>
LCM = 3<sup>2</sup> * 5<sup>3</sup> * 2 = 2250
Largest 4 - digit number = 9999
9999 ÷ 2250 = 4 remainder 999
Required number = 9999 - 999 = 9000
h: चार अंकों की सबसे बड़ी संख्या जो 15, 25, 90 और 125 में से प्रत्येक से पूर्णतः विभाज्य है।

t: The product of two numbers is 38025 and their Highest Common Factor is 65. What is the Least Common Multiple of these numbers?
e:
Since the HCF of two numbers is 65, then let the numbers are 65a and 65b respectively. ['a' and 'b' are co-prime.]
Product of two numbers = 65a X 65b = 38025
ab = 9
LCM of two numbers = 65ab = 65 X 9
= 585
h: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल 38025 है और उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक 65 है, तो इन संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य कितना है?

t: Find the greatest number of five digits which is divisible by 12, 21, 15 and 30.
e:
Greatest number of 5 digits = 99999
Required number must be divisible by LCM of (12, 21, 15 and 30) which is 420.
Dividing 99999 by 420, we get 39 as remainder.
Required number = (99999 - 39) = 99960
h: पाँच अंकों की सबसे बड़ी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 12, 21, 15 और 30 से विभाज्य हो।

t: Three stacks of notebooks contain 288, 432, and 576 notebooks. The notebooks are to be arranged in equal-sized piles. What is the largest number of notebooks per pile, and how many piles will be there in total?
e:
Factor of 288 = 2<sup>5</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup>
Factor of 432 = 2<sup>4 </sup>* 3<sup>3</sup>
Factor of 576 = 2<sup>6</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup>
HCF = 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> = 16 * 9 = 144
288/144 = 2 piles
432/144 = 3 piles
576/144 = 4 piles
Total number of piles = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 piles
h: नोटबुक के तीन ढेरों में क्रमशः 288, 432 और 576 नोटबुक हैं। इन नोटबुक को बराबर आकार के ढेरों में व्यवस्थित किया जाना है। प्रत्येक ढेर में नोटबुक की अधिकतम संख्या क्या है और कुल कितने ढेर होंगे?

t: A shop contains 52 bats, 143 balls, and 104 gloves. The shopkeeper plans to arrange these items in rows in such a way that each row contains the same type of items and an equal number of items. What is the minimum number of rows required for this arrangement?
e:
Total number of bats, balls and gloves in the shop are 52, 143 and 104 respectively.
HCF of 52, 143 and 104 = 13
minimum number of rows required for this arrangement = (52 + 143 + 104)/13 = 23
h: एक दुकान में 52 बल्ले, 143 गेंदें और 104 दस्ताने हैं। दुकानदार इन वस्तुओं को पंक्तियों में इस तरह से व्यवस्थित करने की योजना बनाता है कि प्रत्येक पंक्ति में एक ही प्रकार की वस्तुएँ और समान संख्या में वस्तुएँ हों। इस व्यवस्था के लिए आवश्यक पंक्तियों की न्यूनतम संख्या क्या है?

t: Find the greatest possible length which can be used to measure exactly the lengths 5m 25 cm, 8m 80 cm and 10 m.
e:
5m 25 cm = 525 cm
8m 80 cm = 880 cm
10 m = 1000 cm
Required length = HCF of 525, 880 and 1000
Factors of 525 = 5<sup>2</sup> * 3 * 7
Factors of 880 = 2<sup>4</sup> * 5 * 11
Factors of 1000 = 2<sup>3</sup> * 5<sup>3</sup>
HCF = 5
h: सबसे बड़ी संभव लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका उपयोग 5 मीटर 25 सेमी, 8 मीटर 80 सेमी और 10 मीटर की लंबाई को मापने के लिए किया जा सकता है।

t: The product of the smallest common multiple and the biggest common factor of 45, 90, 120, and 150 is:
e:
Smallest common multiple (L.C.M) of 45, 90, 120, and 150 = 1800
Biggest common factor (H.C.F) of 45, 90, 120, and 150 = 15
Hence, the product of L.C.M and H.C.F = 1800 * 15 = 27000
h: 45, 90, 120 और 150 के लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य और महत्तम समापवर्तक का गुणनफल है:

t: An oil dealer had three types of oil. 403 litres of the first kind, 434 litres of the second kind and 465 litres of the third kind. Find the maximum volume of oil, filled in each barrel, if equal number of barrels are filled.
e:
For equal number of barrels, we have to calculate the HCF of all three types of oil.
HCF of 403, 434, 465 = 31
Maximum volume of oil, filled in each barrel = 31 litres
h: एक तेल विक्रेता के पास तीन प्रकार के तेल थे। पहले प्रकार का 403 लीटर, दूसरे प्रकार का 434 लीटर और तीसरे प्रकार का 465 लीटर। यदि बराबर संख्या में बैरल भरे गए हैं, तो प्रत्येक बैरल में भरे गए तेल की अधिकतम मात्रा ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Choose the correct statement from the following.
o: HCF is the least common multiple of the given numbers.
HCF of two or more numbers is the highest number which perfectly divides all the given numbers.
HCF is also called the least common divisor.
In prime factorization method of HCF, the multiples of all the given numbers are listed.
e:
HCF is highest common factor of the given numbers, so it is the highest number which perfectly divides all the given numbers.
Hence, option (2) is correct.
h: निम्नलिखित में से सही कथन का चयन कीजिए।
oh: महत्तम समापवर्तक दी गई संख्याओं का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य है।
दो या दो से अधिक संख्याओं का महत्तम समापवर्तक वह बड़ी से बड़ी संख्या होती है जो दी गई सभी संख्याओं को पूर्णत: विभाजित कर देती है।
HCF को लघुतम समापवर्तक भी कहा जाता है।

t: A milk vendor has 75 litres of cow milk, 45 litres of toned milk and 30 litres of full cream milk. These should be placed in different trays such that each tray contains the same quantity of milk and two kinds of milk should not be mixed in a tray. What is the least number of trays required to place all the milk?
e:
HCF of 75, 45, 30 = 15
Trays:
Cow: 75 / 15 = 5
Toned: 45 / 15 = 3
Full cream: 30 / 15 = 2
Total = 5 + 3 + 2 = 10
Option (d) is the correct answer.
h: एक दूध विक्रेता के पास 75 लीटर गाय का दूध, 45 लीटर टोंड दूध और 30 लीटर फुल क्रीम दूध है। इन्हें अलग-अलग ट्रे में इस तरह रखना चाहिए कि प्रत्येक ट्रे में दूध की मात्रा समान हो और एक ट्रे में दो तरह के दूध न मिलें। सभी दूध रखने के लिए कम से कम कितनी ट्रे की आवश्यकता होगी?

t: What is the greatest number that will divide 575 and 779 leaving the remainder 31 in both cases?
e:
The remainder of 31 on dividing 575 and 779
That means (575 - 31 = 544) and (779 - 31 = 748) will be divisible by the number.
HCF (544, 748) = 68
h: वह सबसे बड़ी संख्या कौन सी है जो 575 और 779 को विभाजित करने पर दोनों स्थितियों में शेष 31 छोड़ेगी?

t: Three numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 : 9, and their LCM is 1260. What is the difference between the largest and the smallest number?
e: Three no's are = 5x, 7x, 9x LCM = 5 * 7 * 9 * x 5 * 7 * 9 * x = 1260 x = 4 Diff. between largest and smallest = 9x - 5x = 4x = 4 * 4 = 16
h: तीन संख्याएँ 5 : 7 : 9 के अनुपात में हैं और उनका LCM 1260 है। सबसे बड़ी और सबसे छोटी संख्या के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

t: The traffic lights at 3 different road crossings change after every 48 sec, 72 sec and 108 sec, respectively. If they all change simultaneously at 8:20 a.m., then at what time will they next change again simultaneously?
e: LCM of 48, 72 and 108 = 12 * 36 Change time = 12 * 36/60 = 36/5 = 7 min 12 sec. They change together = 8:20 + 7 min 12 sec = 8:27:12 am
h: तीन अलग-अलग सड़क चौराहों पर ट्रैफिक लाइटें क्रमशः 48 सेकंड, 72 सेकंड और 108 सेकंड के बाद बदलती हैं। यदि वे सभी सुबह 8:20 बजे एक साथ बदलती हैं, तो वे अगली बार कब एक साथ बदलेंगी?

t: Three red lights on the same road start blinking at the same time and blink repeatedly after every 4, 6 and 8 minutes, respectively. How many times will they blink together in an interval of 3 hours, excluding blinking together at the starting moment?
e:
LCM of 4, 6, 8 = 24 minutes
Interval = 3 hours = 180 minutes
Number of times when the lights blink together = 180/24 = 7.5 => 7 times
h: एक ही सड़क पर तीन लाल बत्तियाँ एक ही समय पर चमकना शुरू करती हैं और क्रमशः हर 4, 6 और 8 मिनट के बाद बार-बार चमकती हैं। शुरुआती पल में एक साथ चमकने को छोड़कर, 3 घंटे के अंतराल में वे कितनी बार एक साथ चमकेंगी?

t: How many factors of the number 2<sup>7</sup> x 3<sup>5</sup> x 13<sup>6</sup> are even?
e:
The total number of factors = 8 x 6 x 7 = 336
Total number of odd factors = 6 x 7 = 42
So the number of factors = 336 - 42 = 294.
h: संख्या 2<sup>7</sup> x 3<sup>5</sup> x 13<sup>6</sup> के कितने गुणनखंड सम हैं?

t: If A, B, and C are coprime numbers then which of the following is true?
e:
Let A = 3, B = 5, and C = 7,
Now HCF of (A, BC) = HCF of (3, 35) = 1
HCF of (B, AC) = HCF of (5, 21) = 1
Hence option b is true.
h: यदि A, B और C सहअभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विकल्प सत्य है?

t: Find the factors of the expression 3x<sup>2</sup> - 16x + 5.
e:
3x<sup>2</sup> - 16x + 5
= 3x<sup>2</sup> - 15x - x + 5
= 3x (x - 5) - 1 (x - 5)
= (x - 5) (3x - 1)
Hence, required factors are (x - 5) and (3x - 1).
h: व्यंजक 3x<sup>2</sup> - 16x + 5 के गुणनखंड ज्ञात करें

t: A school has 432 pencils, 360 erasers, and 252 sharpeners. These are to be packed into kits such that each kit has the same number of pencils, erasers, and sharpeners. What is the maximum number of kits that can be made?
e:
Factor of 432 = 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>3</sup>
Factor of 360 = 2<sup>3</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 5
Factor of 252 = 2<sup>2</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup> * 7
HCF = 4 * 9 = 36
Maximum number of kits = 36
h: एक स्कूल में 432 पेंसिल, 360 रबड़ और 252 शार्पनर हैं। इन्हें किट में इस तरह पैक किया जाना है कि प्रत्येक किट में पेंसिल, रबड़ और शार्पनर की संख्या समान हो। अधिकतम कितनी किट बनाई जा सकती हैं?

t: Find the greatest two digit number which on dividing 219, 365, 511 leaves the remainders 3, 5, 7, respectively.

t: Five bells commence tolling together and toll at intervals of 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 seconds respectively. In 1 hour 20 minutes, how many times do they toll together?
e: स्मार्ट ट्रिक: LCM = 300s = 5 मिनट. कुल समय = 80 मिनट. बजने की संख्या = (80/5) + 1 (शुरुआती बार) = 16 + 1 = 17 (d)
h: पाँच घंटियाँ एक साथ बजना शुरू करती हैं और क्रमशः 5, 10, 15, 20 और 25 सेकंड के अंतराल पर बजती हैं। 1 घंटा 20 मिनट में वे कितनी बार एक साथ बजेंगी?
eh: स्मार्ट ट्रिक: LCM = 300s = 5 मिनट. कुल समय = 80 मिनट. बजने की संख्या = (80/5) + 1 (शुरुआती बार) = 16 + 1 = 17 (d)

t: If N = 27<sup>19</sup>, then find the total number of factors of N which are perfect cubes.
e:
N = (27)<sup>19</sup> = (3)<sup>3*19</sup> = 3<sup>57</sup>
We know that:
Hence, the total number of perfect cube factors = 57/3 + 1 = 19 + 1 = 20

t: Let the HCF of m and n be 'a' and let n = ab, LCM of m and n is given by:
e: HCF of (m, n) = a (m, ab) -> a (common in both) => LCM * HCF = m * n => LCM * a = m * ab => LCM = mb
h: मान लें कि m और n का महत्तम समापवर्तक 'a' है तथा n = ab है, तो m और n का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य क्या होगा?
eh: स्मार्ट ट्रिक: LCM × HCF = m × n. LCM × a = m × (ab) ⟹ LCM = mb (c)

t: Two numbers are in the ratio of 5 : 13. LCM of the numbers is 520. Find the smaller number among them.
e:
Let, the numbers be 5x and 13x.
LCM = 65x
65x = 520
=> x = 8
Smaller number = 5 * 8 = 40

t: When 1063, 2815 and 3451 are divided by the largest number x, the remainder in each case is y. Find the value of (3x-14y).
e:
The largest such divisor x = HCF of the pairwise differences: (2815-1063), (3451-2815), (3451-1063) = HCF(1752, 636, 2388). Quick HCF via Euclid: HCF(1752,636)=12, HCF(12,2388)=12. So x = 12. Remainder y = 1063 mod 12 = 7 (since 12×88=1056, 1063-1056=7). 3x-14y = 36-98 = -62.

The rule: if three numbers leave the same remainder when divided by x, then x divides all pairwise differences exactly. Differences: 1752, 636, 2388. HCF(1752,636): 1752=2×636+480; 636=1×480+156; 480=3×156+12; 156=13×12+0 → HCF=12. Confirm 2388/12=199 exactly, so x=12 is consistent. y = 1063 mod 12 = 7. 3(12)-14(7) = 36-98 = -62.
h: जब 1063, 2815 और 3451 को सबसे बड़ी संख्या x से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो प्रत्येक स्थिति में शेषफल y होता है। (3x-14y) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The LCM of 672 and 7056 is
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 14112 → ends in 2; (b) 42336 → ends in 6; (c) 28224 → ends in 4; (d) 7056 → ends in 6.
The exact value works out to 14112 (see Solution 2), ending in 2 — only option (a) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

672 = 2⁵×3×7; 7056 = 2⁴×3²×7²
LCM = 2⁵×3²×7² = 32×9×49 = 14,112 → option (a).
h: 672 और 7056 का LCM ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: If the ratio of two numbers is 9 : 8 and their Highest Common Factor (HCF) is 31, then find their Least Common Multiple (LCM).
e:
Look only at the units (ones) digit of each option:
(a) 2256 → ends in 6; (b) 2232 → ends in 2; (c) 2276 → ends in 6; (d) 2244 → ends in 4.
The exact value works out to 2232 (see Solution 2), ending in 2 — only option (b) shares that units digit, so it is the only one that can be correct; the other three are eliminated on sight.

Numbers = 9×31 = 279 and 8×31 = 248.
LCM = 9 × 8 × 31 = 2232 → option (b).
h: यदि दो संख्याओं का अनुपात 9 : 8 है और उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक (HCF) 31 है, तो उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: The product of two numbers is 28224 and their H.C.F. is 56. Find their L.C.M.
e:
Product = HCF × LCM. So LCM = 28224/56. Since 56×500=28000, and 28224 is a bit more, LCM is a little over 500 — closely matching option (c) 504.

Product of numbers = HCF × LCM. So LCM = 28224/56 = 504.
h: दो संख्याओं का गुणनफल 28224 है और उनका महत्तम समापवर्तक (H.C.F.) 56 है। उनका लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (L.C.M.) ज्ञात कीजिए।
